performance.rationale: Reviewed all 18 source-frozen interleaved runs, raw per-run maxima, paired timings and RSS, not only medians. Frame mean medians improve M7 to integrated M8 from 482/889/888 us to 340/565/647 us at 1/4/16 panes; P95 also improves. Identical workloads retain 88771 matches. The earlier unfrozen-source 29.314 ms search tick is preserved in the original report and corrected pending-retest review; it did not recur here: the maximum across all nine candidate runs is 6.253 ms versus baseline 6.989 ms, and no pane median search-tick regression exceeds 10%. Accept three preserved threshold warnings: 1-pane idle CPU rises 263 to 292 microseconds over a two-second idle window (29 microseconds absolute, no frame polling), and system CPU rises by one 10ms accounting quantum at 1 and 4 panes; total process CPU medians are unchanged or lower at all pane counts. Candidate peak RSS rises about 4MiB (under 3%), recorded rather than hidden. Startup medians 39/38/38 ms versus 39/40/38 ms do not reproduce the previous 16-pane startup warning. Acceptance is for the measured ui.Tester developer workload only; no GPU present, end-to-end input latency, GTK/X11, VDI, Linux runtime or PSS claim. These bounded warnings do not block this developer release.
